summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting poll results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 30, 2026. All 10 ordinary resolutions were passed by shareholders, including re-election of directors, reappointment of auditor, and authorizations for share issuance and repurchase mandates. The filing does not involve an M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, or any other special-situations event; it is a routine corporate governance update.
